answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a nebula debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the bridge totals, and the island anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 48 units per epoch, sustaining 261 aliases for 11 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
